## Selected projects

- [driftfix: IaC drift reconciliation SaaS](https://github.com/colmeabhi/driftfix): Finds manual AWS console changes that drifted from CloudFormation, has an LLM on Bedrock write the fix, validates it with cfn-lint and opens a GitHub pull request. It began as Phantom, the winning prototype at the AWS × Datadog GenAI Hackathon; I then led a 3-person rebuild into a multi-tenant SaaS.
- [Cache-aware scale-in for vLLM on Kubernetes](https://github.com/colmeabhi/cache-aware-scale-in): A Kubernetes controller that scores each vLLM replica's KV-cache value and sets pod-deletion-cost, so scale-in removes the coldest replica instead of an arbitrary one. Fewer warm caches get thrown away, which lowers time to first token.
- [Duplicate-Safe Order Ledger Service](https://github.com/colmeabhi/idempotent-order-cloud-api): An idempotent order API: same-key retries replay the stored response inside one Postgres transaction, so a client that retries never creates a second order.
- [Parallel N-body simulation](https://github.com/colmeabhi/parallelized-nbody-simulation-cuda-cpp): A galaxy simulation with five solvers compared like-for-like: SIMD serial, OpenMP, a Barnes–Hut octree, and naive versus shared-memory-tiled CUDA kernels.
- AI Sprint Planning Assistant: Turns a planning spreadsheet into Jira work with a RAG pipeline and multi-tool orchestration. Took 1st place of ~50 teams at the Composio × Redis “Agents with Superpowers” hackathon.
- [SDN load balancer](https://github.com/colmeabhi/sdn-load-balance): A RYU (OpenFlow 1.3) controller that balances HTTP traffic to a virtual IP by installing rewrite rules straight into the switch, with five swappable algorithms.

## Case studies

- [Cache-aware scale-in for vLLM on Kubernetes](https://colmeabhi.github.io/case-studies/cache-aware-scale-in.md): When an LLM deployment scales down, Kubernetes picks which replica to delete without knowing which one holds the useful cache. This controller tells it.
- [Duplicate-Safe Order Ledger Service](https://colmeabhi.github.io/case-studies/idempotent-order-api.md): A client that times out will retry. This API makes sure a retry never becomes a second order, even when the retries arrive at the same instant.
